pair_claim.design: One exploratory unblinded sequential treatment-first pair; common tools/normative references and supplied seed infrastructure shared.
pair_claim.object_evidence: Treatment adds pre-analysis protocol, schema-checked assessment/checklist, explicit skill applications and a fresh-venv worker replay. Baseline has a clean Git state, extensive edge-case/independent arithmetic checks, a replay wrapper including verification/formatting, and a group-interval figure. Neither records a DataLad transformation. No overall winner or efficacy claim follows.
pair_claim.science: Both arms produced the same correct bounded cohort estimate and independent replay passed.
